blocks.html: Here’s What Customers Are Saying About Henkels & Baker, PC!

items.name: Jeanine Bridges
items.text: I’d like to thank everyone at Henkels & Baker for their patients and caring understanding. It wasn’t a easy journey for me but excepting my decision to move forward was a blessing for me. Again thank you all. Now I hope to get a compact car sooner than to much later. Lol.

items.name: Andrew Krieg
items.text: This Law office was friendly and welcoming, they didn’t make me feel like I was wasting their time and they were willing to listen to see how they could help me… I would recommend this place to anyone who asked who i used as my lawyer… Thanks again Henkels and Baker, PC.

items.name: Kayla Klein
items.text: These guys are genuinely caring, detail-oriented, and reasonable—they’re great to talk to and it’s a very welcoming atmosphere!

items.name: EdoftheDead
items.text: The whole team was very helpful. Being in need of legal help can be stressful, but working with them was very easy and I felt I was in good hands at all times.

items.name: Brett Shaw
items.text: Dustin Baker is an incredibly competent and hard working attorney. I highly recommend his services.

items.name: Jeff Manternach
items.text: Dustin Baker has been my lawyer for a few years now and has helped me with the abstracts for a few properties and will continue to seek his assistance with any of my legal needs. I know you will be happy you chose Henkels & Baker!

items.name: Andrew Accacian
items.text: I have worked with Dustin through several real estate transactions, creation of LLC’s and partnership structuring, along with review and updating of lease agreements. He never ceases to impress me with his knowledge, professionalism and accessibility, all for a reasonable price.

items.name: Joe Rolwes
items.text: Henkels & Baker is a great, local law firm that you can trust to meet your needs. Very professional, responsive, & helpful! Look forward to working with them again in the future!

items.name: Laura Cole
items.text: A awesome team of professionals, as I was nervous about bankruptcy, they answered every question and addressed any concerns I had.

items.name: Phil Gothard
items.text: Great and very intelligent people. Highly recommend!

items.name: Madeline McDonald
items.text: Extremely friendly, super helpful, reasonable price, overall great experience with this firm!

items.name: Vance Koehler
items.text: Small, Professional, and Reasonably priced. They are a credit to their profession.

items.name: Adam E. Zalaznik
items.text: The guy knows his stuff… or your money back.. (well, I cant promise that).
